question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Baffle
solution:
The correct answer is '**Amaze**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word '**Baffle**' refers to the state of being perplexed or bewildered. (चकरा देना)

 
 
• **Example**: The sudden twist in the movie's plot **baffled **the audience.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym, '**Amaze**', means to fill with astonishment. (आश्चर्यचकित करना)
 
 
• **Example**: The magic tricks performed by the magician amazed everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym for '**Baffle**' is '**Amaze**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 4**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Enlighten**' means to give someone greater knowledge and understanding about a subject or situation. (प्रकाशित करना)
 
• '**Clear**' means easy to perceive or understand. (स्पष्ट)
 
• '**Comprehend**' means to grasp mentally; understand. (समझना)
